paragraphs: Yirmeya, brother of Ukvan the Babylonian. See the entry Mar Ukva.[^1]

notes.text: The heading explicitly calls Yirmeya the brother of Ukvan the Babylonian. Ukvan (עוקבן) remains distinct from the target Mar Ukva (מר עוקבא); Mar is explicit. The pointer adds no independent identification.
